property: a saturated admin admission budget refuses the operator credential exactly as it refuses any admin module
what a port needs: a native operator (root min3_admin_auth over a native auth image) verified while the admission permit is exhausted: the verdict must be Reject

property: a configuration reload that changes the operator's admin credential (identity-providers.<operator>.settings.sha256) or which admin_auth entry is the operator is applied by the reload alone: root min3_admin_auth::install (min3_admin_auth.rs:31-62) is rerun per candidate (off_path/door_steps.rs:707) with the new config; nothing compares it with the boot binding and no operator audit row is written on reload (busbar-kernel appbuild.rs:2254 accepted_operator runs only when prior.is_none()). The deleted restart comparison returned nothing once no axis opened, so production behaviour did not change.
what a port needs: owner decides: (a) refused as a restart finding, or (b) applied with an operator audit row. Prove with a root test over the reload candidate: boot with sha256 A, reload with sha256 B, assert (a) the reload is refused with a named finding and A still admits, or (b) B admits, A is refused 401, and one operator audit row names the change. Neither is built or proven today.

property: a plane's admin route never sees the admin credential the gate consumed, and its audit row names the authenticated actor
what a port needs: a port_admin test: an admitted admin request reaches the native plane without the consumed credential field, and the audit row's actor is the principal. native admin routes are served by port_admin (plane_driver/port_admin.rs); its tests (port_admin_tests.rs) prove routing only

property: a trust decision a plane relays from an admin route is applied only under the route's granted authority, attributed to the actor, and refused when malformed
what a port needs: a native admin-route trust decision test (if native planes may relay trust decisions at all; if not, a test that they cannot). native admin routes are served by port_admin (plane_driver/port_admin.rs); its tests (port_admin_tests.rs) prove routing only

property: a relayed trust decision whose durable custody fails is not applied in memory
what a port needs: same native seam as the row above: custody failure leaves the in-memory trust book unchanged

property: an admin route not declared with trust verbs cannot decide trust
what a port needs: same native seam: a native admin route without the trust grant is refused a trust decision

property: an authenticated route requires an auth declaration and a caller reference, cannot bypass a revoked destination grant, refuses a missing record without a default scope, bounds its pending wait by the request deadline, and is cancelled before admission on caller stop, reload or drop
what a port needs: native: the port path's authenticated-route admission (plane_driver/authenticated_route.rs if it survives, else its port successor) needs these six cases

property: principal: required refuses an anonymous caller (audited) and admits a verified one; none/optional admit an anonymous caller
what a port needs: a port-path test of the same three cases

property: an old-driver section admission (prepare_admission over InstanceDecl) keeps the live trust approval and work bounds when dropped, rejected or refused at commit, keeps a same-pin approval and requires a new approval for a new pin
what a port needs: native: a port-path instance admission test of the same five cases (pin approval carried only for the same pin)
